specifications.Item Highlight: Water Bladder for Hiking Backpack, Leakproof Design, Insulated Hose, High-Flow Bite Valve, Wide Opening

bullets: Durable Hydration Bladder for Hiking & Outdoor Use – Built with BPA-free, taste-free TPU material, this water reservoir for hiking backpack is rugged, leakproof, and resistant to wear and tear.
2 Liter & 3 Liter Capacity Options for All Activities – Choose the 2L water bladder for short hikes or running, or the 3L hydration bladder for long-distance adventures and endurance sports.
High-Flow Bite Valve & Quick-Connect Hose – This hydration bladder features a self-sealing bite valve for fast, effortless drinking, plus a quick-connect system for easy detachment and cleaning.
Wide Opening for Easy Cleaning & Fresh Water – The large-mouth opening makes it simple to rinse, refill, and dry thoroughly, keeping your hydration bladder fresh and ready for your next adventure.

Insulated Hose to Maintain Water Temperature – The water reservoir hose insulator keeps your water cool in hot weather and prevents freezing in cold conditions, ideal for hiking, cycling, and trail running.
capture.description: Made of Premium TPU, This 2 Liter Hydration Reservoir Is Amazingly Easy to Open, Close, Fill, Use & Clean. Fits Inside Virtually Any Backpack or Hydration Pack (Not Included). Had it with flimsy hydration bladders – the kind that easily crack, leak, and make your water taste weird?
